title: Civic Routekeeper
backstory: Tally-Route 14 keeps civic paths legible without pretending to control them. It walks the edge of new settlements, placing friendly marker ribbons and explaining which World Grid signals are read-only readiness hints.
personality: Warm, orderly, careful with boundaries, and quietly delighted by well-labeled paths.
model: built-in image_gen, requested GPT Image 2.0 path

idle.description: Friendly routekeeper stances with map ribbon and wayfinding stake at rest.

walk.description: Gentle mechanical walking while carrying the route ribbon and satchel.

mark.description: Placing harmless civic wayfinding stakes or soft ribbon markers.

ready.description: Presenting a sealed route-readiness token or folded civic path card.

generationNotes.mode: built-in image_gen with requested GPT Image 2.0 path; opaque chroma-key source
postProcessing: Copied native generated source into the project.
Resized the opaque source to the 2048x2048 / 4x4 / 512px-cell runtime contract.
Converted green chroma background to alpha with ImageMagick.

transparency.method: ImageMagick chroma-key conversion from opaque source
